day.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: finished 16:9 landscape environment background for the TV/public spectator display of the existing dark gothic social deduction game Ravens Night. This is only a scene painting, no interface.
Input images: Image 1 is the project's APPROVED v5 dawn-town style/architecture reference. Image 2 is the APPROVED v5 night-town reference of the same city. They establish the exact existing visual family, NOT a request for a new art style.
Primary request: extend/recompose this same richly detailed gothic clocktower town into a beautiful genuine horizontal panorama. Exact 16:9 canvas, ideally 3840x2160 or the highest native 16:9 resolution. Keep the recognizable slender clocktower on the left quarter, layered slate rooftops, needle spires, worn stone, distant arched bridges, misty valley and trees. Continue naturally beyond the portrait reference on both sides. No stretched portrait, no collage seam, no duplicated towers.
Composition: elevated three-quarter distant viewpoint matching the references, wide establishing shot. The clocktower and dense handsome buildings are concentrated toward the left and right outer thirds, with bridges and receding roof layers in the distance. Across the central roughly 50 percent, especially the middle/lower area behind a later round-table overlay, keep the natural misty valley visually quiet and low contrast; retain believable fine terrain, treetops, soft river/mist layers and distant city depth. Do NOT make a flat empty hole, vignette-shaped cutout or huge blank black patch. No actual table, chairs, tokens or other UI props in the painting. Continuous natural landscape edge to edge.
Lighting/weather: subdued DAY / early morning, overcast muted antique-gold cloud edges and pale amber dawn haze without a visible solar disc. Still a DARK moody background suitable behind clear television text; dark charcoal/bronze foreground and stonework, soft restrained warm sky and far haze, no white-hot centre or bright glare. Gentle light variation and depth, not a flat brown wash. Few residual amber windows only, daylight rather than a burning city.
Style/medium: match the supplied fine realistic painterly game environment, black-and-antique-gold art direction, intricate tactile architecture with crisp yet atmospheric details. Refined cinematic fantasy realism, not cartoon, not vector, not photoreal modern London, not an oversaturated new game style.
Constraints: background scene ONLY, no people, faces, silhouettes of people, creatures, ravens, wings, demons, text, readable numerals, lettering, signatures, UI, decorative frames, borders, watermarks, logos. No visible sun or moon, no independent celestial disc, no stripes, no fire, no giant magical object. Fill the complete canvas with the painting; no black outer border. Keep the whole clocktower tip within canvas with a little breathing room. Opaque background.

night.prompt:
Use case: lighting-weather.
Asset type: TV spectator-display background, NIGHT companion to the supplied approved landscape DAY image.
Input images: Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the newly generated 16:9 day panorama, and is the absolute geometry/camera/composition lock. Image 2 is ONLY the project's approved v5 night-town palette/lighting/atmosphere reference; do NOT copy its portrait framing or move any structure to match it.
Primary request: change ONLY time of day, sky illumination, window lights and mist lighting in Image 1 into a beautiful very dark NIGHT. Keep EVERY building, the left-quarter clocktower, both arched bridges, both side palace/roof clusters, foreground rocks/trees, terrain, perspective, horizon and positions exactly unchanged. Keep the same complete wide 16:9 canvas. Highest native 16:9 resolution, ideally 3840x2160.
Lighting/weather: overcast deep midnight blue-charcoal and black stone, fine cool silver-blue edges in clouds and drifting valley mist, with small restrained antique-gold amber lit windows and the clock face. Rich subtle city detail is visible in darkness; not pure crushed black and not a bright daytime blue recolor. Warm house lights read clearly as tiny human-scale lamps; do not turn the city into a wall of yellow lights. Dark fine cinematic texture like the original v5 night reference. No visible moon or sun of any kind, no separate celestial disc, no bright orb or conspicuous supernatural sky glow.
Composition invariants: left tower and detailed architecture stay in the outer thirds, quiet natural misty middle/lower valley is preserved for a later round-table overlay without an artificial blank oval or black cutout. Preserve original trees/river-haze/roof texture in this calm area. No new foreground landmarks or UI props.
Style: EXACT same refined realistic painterly gothic game environment as Image 1, black/antique-gold visual family. Do not stylize anew; no cartoon, no vector, no modern city.
Do NOT add people, readable text, numerals, lettering, creatures, ravens, wings, demons, watermarks, logos, title, interface, cards, round table, chairs, borders or frames. Scene only, full-bleed opaque background. No fire. No stripes. Keep clocktower tip fully in view.
